dialogues.speaker: Messy Handwriting
dialogues.text: "...To hell with ██ Raskolnikov and his rules! Can't even have a drink anymore. Why, if I could take him in a fight, I'd have grabbed an axe and swung at him from behind..."

dialogues.speaker: Hurried Handwriting
dialogues.text: "...By the Pale Star, get these darn machines to clean this place up immediately! If the Poruchik catches you all having a booze party again, he'll have you all..."
